item: ТЗ-97 Q3 in this commit: ТЗ-73 T4 pinned on the settings tab, and the one clause that did not hold was written. Pinned by tests/test_desktop_task97_q3_settings.py (13 teeth, offline): every ENV_NAMES key carries a sentinel value and no sentinel appears anywhere in the window (labels, line edits, table cells and headers, tree nodes, title) while each name plus «найден, окружение» must appear; KEY_PURPOSE covers the whole list and each absent key's purpose reaches the tab; the limits table equals all_host_limits() by count, host set and numbers, and the «правка» cell reads the config door (0.5 written through set_host_rate_limit shows as 0.5/сек); the catalogue label names the byte count and the pinned mtime to the second, the tab being repainted by selecting the company in the tree (a click, ТЗ-72 S1); a missing catalogue says «базы нет» plus rusterm init. The broken-path clause had no behaviour to pin: catalog_switch_decision knew only db.exists(), so a root whose rusterm.db is not a database was treated as fine and the second window died in the migration door with `sqlite3.DatabaseError: file is not a database`. New branch: usable/reason/closing in the decision, the window answers «каталог не сменён: <слова>; закрывается командой: rusterm --root <путь> init», asks nothing, touches nothing.
step: Q3 network 0 (requests/net_requests stay at the Q2 spend, 38 of 40). Probe root /tmp/q3-probe, never ~/EquityLab (P7). Three shape decisions, each in the code comment: the probe reads the first 16 bytes instead of opening a read-only SQLite connection (a WAL catalogue would look broken, and the button has no right to touch a catalogue the user did not pick); an empty file is not broken, so the older test_catalog_switch_decision_asks_when_missing pin keeps its meaning; usable/closing are new keys, exists kept its meaning, so no assert was re-pointed and the W4 subset-shaped pin stayed green - P1 therefore needed no ЗАМЕНА-БУЛАВКИ block. Two teeth are shaped as they are for measured reasons: mtime is pinned AFTER the build because the build writes the database and the date moves under the assertion, and «no second window over a broken root» is an AST tooth because on the pre-fix code the click reaches raise SystemExit inside a Qt slot and killed the pytest process (the run died after 9 dots with no summary) instead of reporting a red. Red-check at 3694843: 5 failed / 8 passed, the five being exactly the new branch (worktree removed after). Neighbours 190 passed, 1 skipped, 1 deselected, 1 xfailed; report and guide guards 35 passed, 1 skipped. GUIDE.md's settings paragraph now describes both branches of the switch. agent/CONTEXT.md again stayed out of the commit - the baton still names TASK-103 (Disputed 17).
